project.name: armOS Simulator Suite
project.description: A Java-based RISC-V instruction set simulator with 8051 emulator (J51) and ARM support, built with Apache Ant

layers.name: CPU Core Infrastructure

layers.name: 8051 Emulator
layers.description: Intel 8051 (MCS51) microprocessor emulator: CPU core (MCS51), memory model (IRAM, SFR, code, flash), interrupt system, SFR infrastructure, and the complete instruction set with 94 opcode decoders organized by addressing mode and operand type.

layers.name: 8051 MCU Variants & Peripherals
layers.description: Vendor-specific microcontroller implementations (Atmel AT89C51RD2, Philips LPC764/900/936, Silicon Labs C8051F120), hardware device models (UART, Timer0/1/2, I2C bus, EEPROM, LCD display), and the CMON51 debug monitor.

layers.name: 8051 GUI
layers.description: Swing-based graphical user interface for the J51 simulator: main J51 frame, abstract panel base, register/SFR/data/code memory viewers, I/O port panel, UART terminal, assembly/disassembly panel, reusable UI widgets (hex editor, number field, worker dialog), and utility components.

layers.name: NASM Assembler
layers.description: x86 NASM assembly toolchain: SableCC-based parser, intermediate representation with visitor pattern, expression tree (Plus, Minus, Times, Label, Constant, Register), instruction encoding for 20+ x86 instructions, pseudo-instructions (Resb, Resw, Equ, Org), C3a-to-NASM code generator, and runtime evaluator (NasmEval, NasmVM).

layers.name: ARM Emulators
layers.description: Multiple ARM CPU emulator implementations: JARM (full ARM core with CP15 system control, VFPv3 FPU, virtual memory MMU, coprocessor interface), JarmTool (ELF loader, syscall interface), and lxtreme ARM9 with Thumb instruction decoding and condition code execution.

layers.name: RISC-V & Java VM Simulators
layers.description: Alternative CPU architecture simulators: single-cycle RISC-V RV32IM simulator (decoder, execution engine, memory, constants) and Java bytecode interpreter (parser, opcode dispatch, stack-based execution with operand frames, method invocation, library calls).

layers.name: SJC Emulation & Support Libraries

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the four-in-one mission: RISC-V, 8051 (J51), Java bytecode, and ARM simulators under one roof. IsaSim.java is the RV32IM single-cycle entry point — a compact decoder/executor that reads binary files and dumps register state. This file and Decoder.java together establish the simplest simulator pattern in the repo.

tour.title: CPU Core Infrastructure — Shared Interfaces
tour.description: Every simulator in the suite builds on a common contract: iCPU defines CPU lifecycle (reset, step, go, interrupt), iMemory defines byte-level memory access, and Opcode is the instruction interface that all 94 8051 opcodes implement. AbstractOpcode provides the base lifecycle for opcode decoding — parameter extraction, cycle counting, and nesting. These 4 files are the shared vocabulary that lets 8051, ARM, NASM, and RISC-V simulators interoperate.

tour.title: 8051 Emulator Core — MCS51 CPU & Instruction Set
tour.description: The largest subsystem. MCS51.java is the full Intel 8051 family emulator — register banks, SFR space, IRAM/XRAM/code memory, interrupt controller, and the main execute loop. P8051 adds I/O port pin logic. The instruction set is organized as a strategy pattern: base classes like Arithmetic.java delegate to ArithmeticOperation implementations (ADD, ADDC, ANL, ORL, XRL), with 94 concrete opcode classes under the `graph/inst/` directory. MCS51Constants.java defines all SFR register addresses.

tour.title: 8051 MCU Variants & Peripherals
tour.description: Vendor-specific MCU implementations plug into the MCS51 core: AT89C51RD2 (Atmel), LPC764/LPC900/LPC936 (Philips), C8051F120 (Silicon Labs). Peripheral models include UART (serial communication), Timer0/1/2, I2C bus with slave devices, LCD controllers (GLcd, JLcd), and EEPROM (Atmel24C16). The CMON51 debug monitor (Mon51.java) provides a firmware-level debugging interface over UART.

tour.title: 8051 GUI — Swing Debug Interface
tour.description: The J51 simulator's graphical front-end. GUI.java is the main JFrame — CPU selection, file loading (Intel HEX, ELF, JAR), debug controls (run, step, pause, reset), and performance monitoring. Specialized Swing panels (JRegister for register banks, JCode for disassembly, JData/JSfr for memory inspection, JPort for I/O pins, JUart for serial terminal) bind to the MCS51 emulator through J51Panel's CPU reference. Utility widgets (JHexField, JNumField, JBitField) are reused across panels.

tour.title: NASM x86 Assembler — Parser, IR, Encoding, Evaluator
tour.description: A complete x86 NASM assembly toolchain. LoadNasm.java uses a SableCC-generated AST parser to build a NasmInst IR. The IR uses a Visitor pattern (NasmVisitor) over instructions (Add, Mov, Jmp, Call, etc.) and expressions (NasmRegister, NasmConstant, ExpPlus, Label). Each NasmInst subclass encodes its own x86 machine code via bytecode buffers and ModRM stubs. NasmEval provides an interpreter (visitor-based) that runs NASM programs, and NasmVM wraps everything as a command-line tool extending MCS51.

tour.title: ARM Emulators — JARM & lxtreme ARM9
tour.description: Two independent ARM implementations. JARM (src/name/bizna/jarm/CPU.java) is a full ARM core with CP15 system control coprocessor, VFPv3 FPU, virtual memory MMU, and a PhysicalMemorySpace/VirtualMemorySpace memory model. JarmTool.java provides the ELF loader and syscall interface. The lxtreme ARM9 (src/nl/lxtreme/arm/CPU.java) is a lighter implementation that extends MCS51 and supports ARM + Thumb instruction decoding with CPSR/SPSR, condition codes, and syscall handling (SVC).

tour.title: RISC-V & Java VM Simulators
tour.description: Two more CPU architectures rounding out the suite. The RISC-V RV32IM simulator (Decoder.java, IsaSim.java) implements compressed (16-bit) and standard (32-bit) decoding, register file, and a step/execute loop. The Java VM interpreter (ByteCode.java, BytecodeParser.java, BytecodeVisitor.java) implements a full JVM bytecode engine — opcode dispatch via switch/visitor, operand stack frames, method invocation, and library call integration.

tour.title: SJC Emulation & Support Libraries
tour.description: Cross-cutting support infrastructure. The SSA virtual machine (SSAEmul.java, Emulate.java) runs a custom stack-based bytecode with a Swing debugger supporting breakpoints, memory break conditions, method disassembly trees, VGA text display, and BlueJ project metadata. The terminal emulator subsystem (SwingTerminal.java, vt320.java, VDUBuffer.java) provides a VT320-compatible Swing terminal with soft fonts and color management. The x86 disassembler (Disassembler.java) covers IA-32 with ModRM/SIB decoding, based on Bochs.
